ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice rests on capability, not preference. This is a multi-step dividend discount model problem (two-stage growth, present value calculations) with one verifiably correct answer, so raw quantitative/reasoning ability matters most. Willet's reasoning-relevant benchmarks are clearly stronger — MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9 and GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 56.2 — both well beyond run-to-run variance. The task-preference notes (Lapwing's aversion to open-ended generation, Willet's tolerance for distasteful content) are irrelevant to a structured math problem, so they didn't factor in. Willet is simply the more capable model for this deterministic calculation.
